content.hook: Plan riding days, not just kilometres.

scenes.text: Start with the *real distance* from your map or GPX.
Rate each chunk: *surface, heat, wind, rain*.

content.caption:
Bikepacking daily distance: how to plan realistic stages.

100 km on smooth tarmac and 100 km on loose gravel into a headwind are not the same day. Kilometres only tell part of the story.

A calmer way to plan:
• Start with the real route distance.
• Break it into shorter chunks.
• Note the surface, heat, wind and rain for each chunk.
• Plan the day around the hardest chunk, not the easiest.
• Leave some slack for stops, food and the odd detour.

Then you get a number of riding days you can trust, and fewer evenings spent riding in the dark.
